meta.title: Pricing: every MepMail plan on one page
meta.description: MepMail pricing in USD: free with 100 emails/day, Pro from US$ 20 for 110,000 emails/month and Scale up to 2.75M. Overage per 1,000 and no lock-in.
meta.launchDescription: Send Pro 110K: US$29/month; US$20 only for eligible new customers’ first monthly bill, or US$290/year upfront. Mail is a per-mailbox add-on with conditional early access.

title: Pick your volume. <highlight>Pay for what you send.</highlight>
lead: Monthly prices in USD, no lock-in. Every plan runs on your own verified domain and includes assisted onboarding. Use the HTTPS API or SMTP relay, whichever fits your stack.
note: Starting is free: 100 emails a day, no card. Choose a paid plan in the dashboard when you need more volume.

plans.title: The full ladder.
plans.intro: Regular Send monthly fees. The introductory promotion and Pro 110K annual offer appear below when available. Overage depends on your contract and dashboard enablement.

included.title: What every plan carries, Free included.
included.body: Included in every plan. No add-ons needed.
points: Resend-compatible HTTPS API at api-mepmail.je4ndev.com. Keep the official SDK and change the base URL.
SMTP relay with STARTTLS at smtp-mepmail.je4ndev.com:2587.
Your own sending domain, verified with DKIM and MAIL FROM on Amazon SES.
Dedicated API key, delivery logs, suppression list and metrics in the panel.
The official MCP server, so agents send through the same account.

alternatives.title: Coming from Resend?
alternatives.body: We put both ladders side by side, with Resend's public prices and the date they were read.

items.a: Free and Starter stop at the UTC daily limit. Annual Pro 110K has a 110,000 monthly allowance with no paid overage. Monthly Pro and Scale contracts support overage only when contracted and enabled, at their plan’s rate; the safety ceiling remains.

items.q: Is there a contract, and can I change plans later?
items.a: Pro 110K offers monthly and a prepaid 12-month annual period. Annual costs US$290, without stacking the introductory monthly promotion. Available subscription actions appear in the dashboard; existing contracts are preserved.

items.q: What is the attachment limit per message?
items.a: 1 MB on Free and Starter, 5 MB on Pro and 10 MB on Scale. This is the sum of the decoded attachments, not each file separately.

items.q: Do I need a card to start?
items.a: No card is needed to start on Free. The new Pro 110K offer costs US$29/month, with US$20 only for eligible new customers’ first monthly bill, or US$290/year upfront.

items.q: What happens above the top plan?
items.a: The published ladder stops at 2.75M a month. Above that, talk to us: we size the volume with you instead of quoting an enterprise tier we do not publish.

close.title: Pick your rung and send.
close.body: Create the account, verify your domain with our help, and go live through the API or the relay the same day.

launch.title: One monthly allowance. Two ways to pay.
launch.body: 110,000 Send deliveries each month for your application, campaigns and agents. Choose monthly or annual in the dashboard; introductory eligibility is confirmed before checkout.
launch.monthIntro: US$20 only for eligible new customers’ first monthly bill. Renewal: US$29/month.
launch.monthQuota: Overage only when supported by your contract and enabled in the dashboard.
launch.yearUpfront: US$290 paid upfront for 12 months: the price of 10 regular monthly fees. The introduction does not stack.
launch.yearQuota: The 110,000 allowance renews monthly, without an accumulated annual balance. Sending stops at the monthly quota; annual billing does not include metered overage.
launch.preserved: Existing contracts keep their prices and limits; there is no automatic migration. System remains exempt.
launch.mailAccess: Mail is paid separately per mailbox. The first opening is for eligible earlier subscribers; subscribing to Send now does not guarantee early access.
